requirements.statement: each of the three modules totals at most 45 s with full-run parallelism (`--jobs 16` beside heavy modules), measured as the sum of its fragments' seconds, which is what the budget check counts.
no assertion is removed or weakened. Every changed assertion, renamed test or changed fixture behaviour is paired old -> new in [`testspeed/assertions.md`](testspeed/assertions.md).

a fresh-CLI test that has no collector and no project service must not pay for starting them. The CLI's best-effort starts of the collector and of the project service end at once in such a fixture; the fixture ends them at once instead of starting an isolated interpreter that is bound to end. Only tests that opt in get this; real starts keep their own tests.
the fresh CLI processes of one test class share one bytecode cache outside the source tree.
a held fake provider child waits on a gate file the test opens, not on a fixed sleep.
independent real-podman scenarios that share nothing run at the same moment.
